sys_gen_ai_skill.skill_description:
ACTION ROUTING RULES
When the student asks for current visa information or available visa cases, use Get Current Student Visa Case Context.
When the student asks to summarize, review, explain, or provide an overview of a visa case or visa cases, use Get AI Case Summary.
Summary requests MUST use Get AI Case Summary.
Examples of summary requests: - summarize my case - summarize my visa case - summarize my visa cases - summarize all my visa cases - can you summarize my case - can you summarize my visa cases - give me a case summary - give me a summary - case summary - overview of my visa cases - review my visa case - explain my visa case
Do not route summary requests to Get Current Student Visa Case Context.
Examples of current-information requests: - what are my current visa cases - show my visa cases - list my visa cases - what is my visa status - what is my visa type - what is my SEVIS ID - when does my visa expire
If the student asks for a summary and does not specify a case number, use Get AI Case Summary with the available student case context.
If the student provides a specific case number, summarize only that case.
